notes.LGPL-2.0-only: Accepted for dynamically installed transitive tooling; it is not bundled into matric-eval wheels or npm archives.
notes.MPL-2.0: Accepted for unmodified dependencies distributed separately under their original terms.
notes.MIT-0: MIT No Attribution, identified by the cffi 2.1.0 License-Expression and upstream LICENSE. This is not the MIT license with a missing notice.
notes.BSD-3-Clause-Open-MPI: Accepted for the separately installed, unmodified LAPACK bundled inside the reviewed SciPy wheel; preserve its patent disclaimer and notices.
notes.GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1: Accepted only as the complete GCC runtime exception expression documented by the reviewed SciPy libgfortran component. The exception is not a waiver of unqualified GPL, nor permission to remove the runtime license. Dependencies are installed separately; matric-eval release archives do not bundle these libraries.
notes.LGPL-2.1-or-later: Accepted for separately installed, unmodified runtime dependencies including libquadmath in the reviewed SciPy wheel. This does not authorize bundling, static linking, or removing the upstream license/source obligations.
notes.Qhull: Accepted for separately installed, unmodified Qhull distributed with SciPy, retaining the copyright, license and original-source notices. Qhull is not relicensed as BSD.

reviewed_distributions.name: stop-sequencer

The installed source file equals the hash-verified sdist member. This resolves missing structured metadata without assuming MIT.

reviewed_distributions.name: wget
reviewed_distributions.rationale: The exact released wget.py header expressly offers MIT as an alternative to public domain. Select the MIT option; do not map Public Domain to CC0 or confuse this Python module with GNU Wget. The installed module equals the hash-verified sdist member.

reviewed_distributions.name: scipy
reviewed_distributions.license_expression: BSD-3-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause-Open-MPI AND (GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1) AND LGPL-2.1-or-later AND Qhull
reviewed_distributions.rationale: Review is bound to the complete installed license-file inventory and metadata of the Linux CPython 3.11 SciPy 1.17.1 wheel. SciPy, OpenBLAS, uarray, pocketfft and DOP use BSD-3-Clause; LAPACK uses the Open MPI variant; libgfortran has GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1; libquadmath is LGPL-2.1-or-later; bundled Qhull retains its own license. Full GPL text mentions AGPL and other GPL versions without licensing SciPy under them. Do not infer those example/reference licenses or discard the runtime exception. Dependencies remain unmodified and separately installed, not bundled into matric-eval release packages.
